title: Natal Planets and Points in Houses
description: Original concise interpretations of 14 planets and points across all 12 natal houses. These describe body-in-house symbolism, not zodiac signs on house cusps or combined body-sign-house interpretations.
interpretation_note: Modern Western astrological symbolism for reflection, not predictions or guarantees. Interpret alongside the whole chart, including signs and aspects. Lunar node entries describe symbolic growth themes, not factual claims about past lives.

lookup.point_key_rule: Use the lower-case subject_data property name; resolve point_aliases before reading meanings.
lookup.node_rule: Use either the mean or true node calculation chosen for the chart, not both as separate placements. The same text applies once each node's actual house is determined.
lookup.lilith_rule: Lilith means Black Moon Lilith (the lunar apogee), not asteroid 1181 Lilith.

excluded_angles.reason: Angles are chart reference points and need their own descriptions rather than a generic 12-house planet lookup. Ascendant and Descendant mark the first and seventh cusps in common natal house systems. MC and IC mark the tenth and fourth cusps in quadrant systems such as Placidus; their house positions can differ in whole-sign or equal-house systems.

sun.First_House: The Sun in the 1st house places self-expression and personal presence at the centre of life. Confidence grows through taking initiative and discovering an identity that feels authentic, while leaving room for other people to shine.
sun.Second_House: The Sun in the 2nd house connects identity with personal values, resources and self-worth. Building something lasting can bring fulfilment, while learning to value yourself beyond earnings or possessions supports a steadier sense of confidence.
sun.Third_House: The Sun in the 3rd house brings self-expression into communication, learning and everyday connections. Sharing ideas and developing your own voice can strengthen confidence, especially when curiosity matters as much as having the answer.
sun.Fourth_House: The Sun in the 4th house roots identity in home, family and private life. Creating a place of belonging can feel deeply meaningful, alongside deciding which inherited traditions reflect the person you are becoming.
sun.Fifth_House: The Sun in the 5th house encourages creative expression, play and the pleasure of being yourself. Art, romance or time with children may bring fulfilment, with confidence growing when enjoyment matters more than applause.
sun.Sixth_House: The Sun in the 6th house connects purpose with useful work, everyday routines and practical service. Developing skills can bring satisfaction, while allowing rest and imperfection helps keep usefulness from becoming the measure of your worth.
sun.Seventh_House: The Sun in the 7th house brings identity into focus through close relationships and collaboration. Partnership can reveal important qualities in you, while maintaining your own interests gives connection a stronger foundation.
sun.Eighth_House: The Sun in the 8th house draws identity towards intimacy, shared resources and deeper questions of trust. Honest engagement with change can build confidence, especially when closeness allows both people to retain their independence.
sun.Ninth_House: The Sun in the 9th house connects purpose with discovery, education, travel and the search for meaning. Exploring unfamiliar perspectives can expand your sense of self, while staying curious keeps conviction from becoming certainty about everyone else's path.
sun.Tenth_House: The Sun in the 10th house emphasises public contribution, ambition and the wish to do meaningful work. Recognition may matter, but lasting fulfilment comes from defining success in ways that reflect your own values.
sun.Eleventh_House: The Sun in the 11th house connects identity with friendships, communities and hopes for the future. Contributing to a shared goal can feel energising, while expressing your individuality helps you find a genuine place within the group.
sun.Twelfth_House: The Sun in the 12th house turns attention towards solitude, imagination and life behind the scenes. Quiet reflection or compassionate work can provide purpose, with confidence growing when you recognise contributions that do not attract public attention.

moon.First_House: The Moon in the 1st house brings feelings close to the surface, shaping personal presence and instinctive reactions. Emotional awareness can make your manner responsive and expressive, while a pause helps you choose how to act on changing moods.
moon.Second_House: The Moon in the 2nd house connects emotional security with stability, familiar comforts and personal resources. A dependable foundation can be reassuring, while recognising non-material sources of support helps ease the need to control every uncertainty.
moon.Third_House: The Moon in the 3rd house weaves emotion into conversation, learning and everyday encounters. Talking or writing can help you understand your feelings, especially when there is space to listen as well as explain.
moon.Fourth_House: The Moon in the 4th house anchors emotional life in home, family and a sense of belonging. Familiar spaces and private rituals can offer comfort, while making room for present needs helps inherited patterns evolve.
moon.Fifth_House: The Moon in the 5th house finds emotional nourishment through creativity, play, affection and heartfelt expression. Romance or relationships with children may feel especially meaningful, while everyday sources of joy help support a steadier inner life.
moon.Sixth_House: The Moon in the 6th house connects emotional wellbeing with daily rhythms, practical care and the atmosphere at work. Supportive routines can offer reassurance, while flexibility helps when a day refuses to follow the plan.
moon.Seventh_House: The Moon in the 7th house places emotional importance on close partnership and mutual support. Sharing life can bring comfort, while naming your needs clearly helps you stay connected without relying on someone else to manage every feeling.
moon.Eighth_House: The Moon in the 8th house deepens emotional investment in intimacy, trust and shared responsibilities. Feeling safe enough to be vulnerable matters, while clear boundaries help distinguish your feelings from the burdens you take on for others.
moon.Ninth_House: The Moon in the 9th house finds emotional nourishment in discovery, meaningful beliefs and a wider view of life. Travel or study may offer renewal, while familiar rituals can provide comfort wherever your curiosity takes you.
moon.Tenth_House: The Moon in the 10th house connects emotional needs with public life, responsibility and being valued for your contribution. Work can carry personal meaning, while private sources of reassurance help when recognition is uncertain.
moon.Eleventh_House: The Moon in the 11th house seeks emotional belonging through friendship, community and shared hopes. A supportive circle can feel like family, while making space for your own needs prevents group harmony from becoming an obligation.
moon.Twelfth_House: The Moon in the 12th house gives emotional life a private, reflective quality. Solitude, dreams or creative expression can help feelings become clearer, while trusted companionship keeps time alone from turning into isolation.

mercury.First_House: Mercury in the 1st house makes communication and curiosity prominent parts of personal expression. Thinking aloud and asking questions can help you engage with life, while listening gives your quick impressions room to develop.
mercury.Second_House: Mercury in the 2nd house directs thought towards values, money and the practical use of skills. Planning and negotiation may help you manage resources, while remembering what cannot be measured keeps decisions grounded in more than figures.
mercury.Third_House: Mercury in the 3rd house emphasises language, learning and the exchange of everyday information. Writing, conversation and local connections can keep the mind engaged, while focused attention helps curiosity become useful understanding.
mercury.Fourth_House: Mercury in the 4th house turns the mind towards home, family stories and private reflection. Talking through shared history can bring insight, while questioning inherited assumptions helps you form a perspective of your own.
mercury.Fifth_House: Mercury in the 5th house brings ideas into creative expression, humour, storytelling and play. Words can be a source of pleasure and attraction, while experimenting freely gives imagination more room than trying to be impressive.
mercury.Sixth_House: Mercury in the 6th house focuses the mind on tasks, routines and practical problem-solving. Attention to detail can improve everyday work, while knowing when something is good enough helps prevent constant mental overwork.
mercury.Seventh_House: Mercury in the 7th house makes dialogue central to partnership and collaboration. Exchanging perspectives can clarify decisions, while speaking directly about disagreements helps conversation become a meeting of minds rather than a contest.
mercury.Eighth_House: Mercury in the 8th house draws thought towards private matters, shared finances and the motives beneath the surface. Careful questions can support trust, while respecting what others choose to disclose keeps curiosity from becoming intrusion.
mercury.Ninth_House: Mercury in the 9th house connects learning with philosophy, higher education and unfamiliar cultures. Comparing ideas can broaden understanding, while checking details helps a persuasive theory hold up in practice.
mercury.Tenth_House: Mercury in the 10th house brings communication, planning and knowledge into public life. Writing, teaching or explaining ideas may support your contribution, while clear and consistent words help build a reputation people can trust.
mercury.Eleventh_House: Mercury in the 11th house finds stimulation through friendships, networks and collective projects. Exchanging ideas can turn shared hopes into plans, while welcoming different opinions makes collaboration more thoughtful and useful.
mercury.Twelfth_House: Mercury in the 12th house gives thought a private, imaginative or reflective quality. Writing and quiet time can help half-formed impressions become clear, while checking assumptions helps distinguish insight from what has gone unsaid.

venus.First_House: Venus in the 1st house brings charm, aesthetic awareness and a wish for harmony into personal expression. Style and warmth can help you connect with others, while honest preferences matter as much as making a pleasing impression.
venus.Second_House: Venus in the 2nd house connects pleasure with comfort, beauty and the things you value. Enjoying quality can make everyday life richer, while thoughtful spending helps appreciation remain aligned with your resources and priorities.
venus.Third_House: Venus in the 3rd house brings warmth and tact to conversation, learning and everyday relationships. Words, stories or small gestures can create connection, while clear disagreement allows kindness to remain honest.
venus.Fourth_House: Venus in the 4th house finds pleasure in a welcoming home, familiar company and private affection. Creating beauty in your surroundings can feel nourishing, while genuine closeness leaves room for feelings that are less comfortable.
venus.Fifth_House: Venus in the 5th house encourages romance, creativity and enjoyment for its own sake. Art, play and affectionate expression can bring delight, while allowing pleasure to be simple keeps it from depending on constant excitement.
venus.Sixth_House: Venus in the 6th house expresses affection through practical help, everyday consideration and shared routines. A pleasant working atmosphere can matter deeply, while reciprocity keeps caring gestures from becoming an unspoken duty.
venus.Seventh_House: Venus in the 7th house places value on partnership, cooperation and mutual affection. Close relationships can bring pleasure and companionship, while expressing your own preferences helps harmony grow from understanding rather than avoidance.
venus.Eighth_House: Venus in the 8th house seeks depth, trust and generosity in intimate relationships. Sharing emotional or material resources may strengthen connection, while clear agreements help affection coexist with healthy independence.
venus.Ninth_House: Venus in the 9th house finds beauty in discovery, learning and different ways of life. Shared beliefs or new experiences may encourage affection, while curiosity helps you appreciate differences without idealising what feels unfamiliar.
venus.Tenth_House: Venus in the 10th house brings relationship skills, aesthetic judgement or a wish for harmony into public life. Collaborative work can be fulfilling, while a reputation built on genuine values lasts beyond simply being liked.
venus.Eleventh_House: Venus in the 11th house finds affection and pleasure through friendship, community and shared interests. Love may grow from companionship, while personal attention helps close bonds flourish within a wider social circle.
venus.Twelfth_House: Venus in the 12th house gives affection a private, compassionate or imaginative expression. Quiet creativity and gentle acts of care can feel meaningful, while clear boundaries help you love without disappearing into someone else's needs.

mars.First_House: Mars in the 1st house brings initiative, directness and a strong impulse to act into personal expression. Pursuing your own direction can be energising, while choosing your battles helps courage become effective rather than reactive.
mars.Second_House: Mars in the 2nd house directs effort towards earning, protecting resources and pursuing what you value. Practical goals can motivate sustained action, while separating urgency from necessity helps prevent impulsive spending or unnecessary conflict.
mars.Third_House: Mars in the 3rd house energises communication, learning and everyday activity. Debate and quick decisions may come naturally, while pausing before responding helps strong opinions become constructive rather than combative.
mars.Fourth_House: Mars in the 4th house channels energy into home, family responsibilities and the protection of private space. Improving your surroundings can be satisfying, while direct discussion helps household tensions find a useful outlet.
mars.Fifth_House: Mars in the 5th house brings enthusiasm to creativity, romance, competition and play. Taking a creative risk can feel invigorating, while respecting others' pace keeps excitement from becoming pressure.
mars.Sixth_House: Mars in the 6th house directs energy towards work, routines and practical improvement. Tackling tasks can be rewarding, while pacing effort and allowing recovery helps prevent every day from becoming a test of endurance.
mars.Seventh_House: Mars in the 7th house brings drive and directness into partnership and collaboration. Shared challenges can energise a relationship, while fair disagreement helps each person assert their needs without turning the bond into a competition.
mars.Eighth_House: Mars in the 8th house intensifies effort around intimacy, shared resources and questions of control. Difficult subjects may invite decisive action, while clear consent and shared decision-making keep determination from becoming pressure.
mars.Ninth_House: Mars in the 9th house energises the pursuit of knowledge, travel and strongly held beliefs. Defending a principle can feel motivating, while curiosity helps conviction leave room for experiences that challenge your assumptions.
mars.Tenth_House: Mars in the 10th house directs ambition towards public goals, leadership and visible achievement. Taking initiative can move work forward, while thoughtful priorities help you pursue success without making every interaction a contest.
mars.Eleventh_House: Mars in the 11th house channels effort into friendships, group projects and hopes for the future. Collective action can be motivating, while agreeing on responsibilities helps strong initiative support rather than overwhelm the group.
mars.Twelfth_House: Mars in the 12th house gives drive a private or indirect expression. Solitary projects and work behind the scenes can provide an outlet, while recognising frustration early helps you express needs before resentment builds.

jupiter.First_House: Jupiter in the 1st house brings an expansive, hopeful approach to personal growth. New experiences can strengthen confidence, while realistic commitments help enthusiasm become something you can sustain.
jupiter.Second_House: Jupiter in the 2nd house encourages growth through resources, skills and a generous relationship with what you own. Developing your abilities may open possibilities, while moderation helps optimism remain compatible with practical limits.
jupiter.Third_House: Jupiter in the 3rd house encourages curiosity, communication and everyday learning. Siblings, neighbours and local connections may broaden your perspective, while sharing ideas generously can turn ordinary encounters into useful opportunities.
jupiter.Fourth_House: Jupiter in the 4th house connects growth with home, family and a sense of belonging. A supportive private life can give you room to flourish, while hospitality works best when generosity respects your own capacity.
jupiter.Fifth_House: Jupiter in the 5th house expands enthusiasm for creativity, romance, play and self-expression. Taking imaginative chances may bring fulfilment, while a sense of proportion keeps enjoyment from depending on ever greater excitement.
jupiter.Sixth_House: Jupiter in the 6th house finds growth through useful work, learning skills and contributing to everyday life. A generous approach can support collaboration, while manageable commitments help you offer assistance without taking on too much.
jupiter.Seventh_House: Jupiter in the 7th house encourages growth through partnership, cooperation and the exchange of perspectives. Supportive relationships can broaden possibilities, while realistic expectations help generosity become mutual rather than assumed.
jupiter.Eighth_House: Jupiter in the 8th house explores growth through intimacy, shared resources and deeper understanding. Honest cooperation can strengthen trust, while careful agreements help hopeful plans respect financial and emotional realities.
jupiter.Ninth_House: Jupiter in the 9th house emphasises discovery, higher learning, travel and the search for meaning. Exploring different perspectives may feel rewarding, while humility keeps a strong belief system open to new understanding.
jupiter.Tenth_House: Jupiter in the 10th house connects growth with vocation, leadership and public contribution. Mentors or meaningful responsibilities may broaden your path, while realistic goals help ambition grow through substance rather than promises.
jupiter.Eleventh_House: Jupiter in the 11th house finds possibility through friendships, communities and shared aspirations. A generous network can support learning and collaboration, while choosing priorities helps a hopeful vision become practical collective work.
jupiter.Twelfth_House: Jupiter in the 12th house encourages growth through reflection, compassion and quiet exploration of meaning. Solitude or service may restore perspective, while staying connected to everyday responsibilities helps inner faith support practical life.

saturn.First_House: Saturn in the 1st house brings seriousness, caution and a wish to be capable into personal expression. Confidence may develop through experience, while allowing mistakes helps responsibility become self-trust rather than constant self-monitoring.
saturn.Second_House: Saturn in the 2nd house emphasises responsibility around money, resources and self-worth. Patient planning can build stability, while recognising your value beyond productivity helps security feel less dependent on having everything under control.
saturn.Third_House: Saturn in the 3rd house approaches communication and learning with care, structure and a need for accuracy. Practice can develop a reliable voice, while permission to ask questions eases the pressure to speak only when certain.
saturn.Fourth_House: Saturn in the 4th house places responsibility and the need for stability within home and family life. Creating dependable foundations can matter deeply, while sharing obligations helps private life provide comfort as well as duty.
saturn.Fifth_House: Saturn in the 5th house brings discipline or hesitation into creativity, romance and play. Regular practice can develop a creative skill, while allowing enjoyment without a useful outcome makes pleasure easier to receive.
saturn.Sixth_House: Saturn in the 6th house emphasises duty, structure and high standards in everyday work. Sustainable routines can support competence, while rest and reasonable limits help discipline serve your life instead of consuming it.
saturn.Seventh_House: Saturn in the 7th house takes partnership, commitment and shared responsibilities seriously. Trust may develop gradually through consistency, while flexibility and honest affection keep a dependable bond from becoming only an obligation.
saturn.Eighth_House: Saturn in the 8th house approaches intimacy, shared resources and dependence with caution. Clear agreements can build trust over time, while accepting appropriate support helps self-protection leave room for closeness.
saturn.Ninth_House: Saturn in the 9th house seeks a firm foundation for beliefs, education and a wider understanding of life. Disciplined study can develop wisdom, while allowing unanswered questions keeps structure from narrowing your perspective.
saturn.Tenth_House: Saturn in the 10th house emphasises responsibility, public standards and achievement built over time. Steady effort can develop authority, while defining enough for yourself helps ambition avoid becoming an endless demand to prove your worth.
saturn.Eleventh_House: Saturn in the 11th house brings seriousness and selectivity to friendships, communities and long-term hopes. Reliable collaboration may matter more than a large circle, while shared responsibility prevents belonging from depending entirely on what you provide.
saturn.Twelfth_House: Saturn in the 12th house turns responsibility towards private fears, inner discipline and work behind the scenes. Gentle structure can support reflection, while expressing hidden burdens to trusted people helps solitude become restorative rather than demanding.

uranus.First_House: Uranus in the 1st house emphasises individuality, experimentation and freedom in personal expression. Reinventing your approach can feel energising, while a few dependable anchors help change remain a choice rather than a constant necessity.
uranus.Second_House: Uranus in the 2nd house questions conventional ideas about earning, ownership and security. Unusual skills or flexible arrangements may appeal, while practical reserves can support experimentation without making stability depend on the next new idea.
uranus.Third_House: Uranus in the 3rd house brings originality and a questioning approach to communication and learning. Unexpected connections can produce useful insights, while explaining your reasoning helps others follow the leap.
uranus.Fourth_House: Uranus in the 4th house seeks freedom to define home and family life in your own way. Unconventional arrangements may feel comfortable, while clear expectations help independence coexist with dependable belonging.
uranus.Fifth_House: Uranus in the 5th house encourages experimentation in creativity, romance and play. Original projects and unusual interests may be stimulating, while honesty about your need for space helps excitement coexist with consideration.
uranus.Sixth_House: Uranus in the 6th house looks for flexibility and better methods in work and daily routines. Experimenting with tools or schedules can be productive, while retaining useful habits keeps novelty from disrupting what already supports you.
uranus.Seventh_House: Uranus in the 7th house values independence and individuality within close relationships. Partnerships may thrive with flexible agreements, while consistency and open communication help freedom feel secure for everyone involved.
uranus.Eighth_House: Uranus in the 8th house questions familiar arrangements around intimacy, shared money and dependence. New approaches may create room for change, while mutual agreement helps experimentation respect trust and shared responsibilities.
uranus.Ninth_House: Uranus in the 9th house challenges established beliefs and conventional paths of learning. Unusual subjects or experiences can broaden your outlook, while examining alternative ideas critically keeps originality connected to understanding.
uranus.Tenth_House: Uranus in the 10th house seeks room for innovation and independence in public life or vocation. A less conventional path may feel meaningful, while practical planning helps a change of direction become sustainable.
uranus.Eleventh_House: Uranus in the 11th house finds stimulation through unusual friendships, progressive ideas and collective experimentation. Shared visions can inspire collaboration, while respect for individual differences helps a group practise the freedom it values.
uranus.Twelfth_House: Uranus in the 12th house brings unconventional ideas into private reflection and life behind the scenes. Quiet experimentation may uncover a different approach, while giving insights a practical outlet helps inner change become useful.

neptune.First_House: Neptune in the 1st house gives personal expression an imaginative, receptive or elusive quality. Sensitivity to atmosphere can shape first impressions, while clear preferences help you remain grounded in your own identity.
neptune.Second_House: Neptune in the 2nd house connects values and resources with imagination, generosity or ideals. Meaningful work may matter more than status, while clear budgets and agreements help inspiration remain compatible with material needs.
neptune.Third_House: Neptune in the 3rd house brings imagination and sensitivity to communication and learning. Stories, images or music may convey what ordinary explanations miss, while checking details helps impressions become reliable understanding.
neptune.Fourth_House: Neptune in the 4th house adds longing, imagination and idealism to home and family life. Creating a peaceful refuge may feel important, while seeing loved ones clearly helps belonging rest on reality as well as hope.
neptune.Fifth_House: Neptune in the 5th house nourishes creative imagination, romantic ideals and the pleasure of make-believe. Art can offer a rich outlet, while allowing people to be imperfect helps affection grow beyond an imagined story.
neptune.Sixth_House: Neptune in the 6th house seeks meaning and compassion in everyday work and service. A gentle rhythm can support focus, while clear tasks and boundaries help goodwill avoid becoming confusion about what is yours to do.
neptune.Seventh_House: Neptune in the 7th house brings idealism, empathy and longing into partnership. A deep sense of connection may be appealing, while clear expectations help you recognise the person in front of you as well as their possibilities.
neptune.Eighth_House: Neptune in the 8th house adds sensitivity and idealism to intimacy, trust and shared resources. Emotional closeness may feel profound, while transparent agreements help prevent generosity or unspoken assumptions from blurring boundaries.
neptune.Ninth_House: Neptune in the 9th house seeks meaning through imagination, spirituality, art or expansive beliefs. Wonder can enrich your outlook, while checking claims and questioning authority helps inspiration remain connected to discernment.
neptune.Tenth_House: Neptune in the 10th house brings ideals, imagination or compassionate aims into public life. Creative or supportive work may feel meaningful, while clear goals help turn a compelling vision into a practical contribution.
neptune.Eleventh_House: Neptune in the 11th house invests hope and imagination in friendships, communities and a better future. Shared ideals can inspire kindness, while realistic expectations help you notice whether a group's actions match its promises.
neptune.Twelfth_House: Neptune in the 12th house emphasises imagination, private reflection and sensitivity to subtle impressions. Solitude or creative practice may feel restorative, while ordinary routines and trusted connections help keep inner exploration grounded.

pluto.First_House: Pluto in the 1st house brings intensity and a wish for personal agency into self-expression. Changes in identity may invite deep reflection, while using influence thoughtfully helps strength coexist with openness.
pluto.Second_House: Pluto in the 2nd house draws attention to control, attachment and security around money or possessions. Reconsidering what you value can be transformative, while building varied sources of support eases dependence on any single resource.
pluto.Third_House: Pluto in the 3rd house gives thought and communication an investigative, penetrating quality. Looking beneath an explanation can reveal useful detail, while careful language helps insight deepen understanding without becoming a way to dominate.
pluto.Fourth_House: Pluto in the 4th house draws attention to deep patterns within home, family and private life. Examining inherited expectations can support change, while creating your own boundaries helps belonging develop on terms you can live with.
pluto.Fifth_House: Pluto in the 5th house brings intensity to creativity, romance and personal expression. Meaningful projects can provide an outlet for powerful feelings, while allowing freedom in affection helps passion coexist with trust.
pluto.Sixth_House: Pluto in the 6th house focuses intensity on work, routines and the wish to improve what is not functioning. Thorough effort can create change, while proportionate standards keep improvement from becoming a need to control every detail.
pluto.Seventh_House: Pluto in the 7th house brings questions of trust, influence and shared power into close relationships. Honest dialogue can deepen intimacy, while mutual independence protects connection from pressure, testing or attempts to control the other person.
pluto.Eighth_House: Pluto in the 8th house emphasises intimacy, shared resources and the deeper meanings of dependence and change. Facing difficult conversations can strengthen agency, while transparency and consent help trust develop without surrendering personal boundaries.
pluto.Ninth_House: Pluto in the 9th house examines the beliefs and assumptions that organise your understanding of life. Deep study can reshape perspective, while intellectual humility helps conviction remain open to evidence and different experiences.
pluto.Tenth_House: Pluto in the 10th house brings intensity to vocation, authority and public influence. Meaningful responsibility may inspire strong commitment, while examining your motives helps ambition serve a contribution rather than a need for control.
pluto.Eleventh_House: Pluto in the 11th house draws attention to power and belonging within friendships or communities. Collective projects may inspire deep investment, while transparent decisions and healthy boundaries help shared purpose respect individual agency.
pluto.Twelfth_House: Pluto in the 12th house turns attention towards private patterns, hidden motives and difficult-to-name attachments. Honest reflection can make choices clearer, while patient support helps inner change develop without needing to solve everything alone.

chiron.First_House: Chiron in the 1st house may bring sensitivity around identity, visibility or feeling accepted as you are. Confidence can grow through compassionate self-expression and relationships that make room for individuality without demanding constant self-correction.
chiron.Second_House: Chiron in the 2nd house may bring sensitivity around worth, adequacy or having enough. Recognising the value of your presence and abilities can support self-trust, alongside practical care for the resources that help you feel secure.
chiron.Third_House: Chiron in the 3rd house may highlight sensitivity around speaking, learning or being understood. Patient conversation and different forms of expression can help you trust your voice without treating every misunderstanding as a judgement of your ability.
chiron.Fourth_House: Chiron in the 4th house may bring sensitivity around home, family or belonging. Building supportive connections and private rituals can help create a sense of safety that reflects your current needs as well as your history.
chiron.Fifth_House: Chiron in the 5th house may highlight vulnerability around creativity, enjoyment or being noticed. Small acts of playful expression can rebuild confidence, especially when you allow pleasure without needing to be talented, impressive or praised.
chiron.Sixth_House: Chiron in the 6th house may bring sensitivity around usefulness, competence or meeting daily expectations. Flexible routines and realistic standards can support confidence, while recognising that needing rest or help does not diminish your contribution.
chiron.Seventh_House: Chiron in the 7th house may highlight vulnerability around acceptance, equality or being chosen in close relationships. Clear needs and reciprocal care can support trust, while making room for individuality helps connection feel less like a test.
chiron.Eighth_House: Chiron in the 8th house may bring sensitivity around trust, dependence or sharing vulnerable parts of yourself. Closeness can develop through gradual disclosure and respectful boundaries, without requiring you to prove trust by giving more than feels right.
chiron.Ninth_House: Chiron in the 9th house may highlight uncertainty around belonging within a belief system or trusting your understanding of life. Exploring different perspectives can support confidence, especially when questions are welcomed rather than treated as failures.
chiron.Tenth_House: Chiron in the 10th house may bring sensitivity around achievement, recognition or being taken seriously. Defining a meaningful contribution in your own terms can strengthen confidence beyond titles, approval or comparisons with another person's progress.
chiron.Eleventh_House: Chiron in the 11th house may highlight vulnerability around friendship, inclusion or finding your place in a group. Supportive communities can encourage self-acceptance, while smaller, reciprocal connections may matter more than fitting into every circle.
chiron.Twelfth_House: Chiron in the 12th house may bring sensitivity that is easier to feel than explain. Quiet creativity, reflection and trusted support can help give those feelings a voice, without requiring a single explanation for every vulnerable moment.

lilith.First_House: Black Moon Lilith in the 1st house explores the tension between authentic self-expression and pressure to appear acceptable. Owning your presence can feel liberating, while choosing how to express anger or defiance helps independence remain intentional.
lilith.Second_House: Black Moon Lilith in the 2nd house explores autonomy around money, desire and personal values. Deciding what is worth your effort can strengthen self-respect, while separating genuine needs from reactions to other people's expectations clarifies your choices.
lilith.Third_House: Black Moon Lilith in the 3rd house explores the freedom to speak about what is difficult, unpopular or usually left unsaid. Direct expression can feel empowering, while listening and precision help a challenging message become understandable.
lilith.Fourth_House: Black Moon Lilith in the 4th house explores authenticity within home, family and inherited expectations. Defining your own private space can strengthen autonomy, while clear boundaries help you choose which traditions and responsibilities you want to carry.
lilith.Fifth_House: Black Moon Lilith in the 5th house explores unapologetic creativity, desire and the right to enjoy being yourself. Expressive freedom can be rewarding, while consent and consideration allow pleasure without needing approval or provoking a reaction.
lilith.Sixth_House: Black Moon Lilith in the 6th house explores resistance to restrictive roles in work, service and everyday expectations. Fair boundaries can protect your autonomy, while choosing practical ways to challenge an arrangement makes resistance more effective.
lilith.Seventh_House: Black Moon Lilith in the 7th house explores equality, desire and autonomy within close partnership. Naming what you will not compromise can support honest connection, while recognising each person's agency keeps independence from becoming a struggle for control.
lilith.Eighth_House: Black Moon Lilith in the 8th house explores taboo subjects, intimacy and the right to decide what you share. Honest boundaries can support trust, while separating desire from pressure helps closeness remain freely chosen.
lilith.Ninth_House: Black Moon Lilith in the 9th house explores the freedom to question moral rules, accepted beliefs and claims of authority. Forming your own outlook can feel empowering, while curiosity keeps opposition from becoming another unquestioned position.
lilith.Tenth_House: Black Moon Lilith in the 10th house explores autonomy in public life and resistance to restrictive definitions of success. Claiming your ambitions can be meaningful, while deliberate choices help you challenge expectations without letting them define your direction.
lilith.Eleventh_House: Black Moon Lilith in the 11th house explores individuality, exclusion and the pressure to conform within groups. Finding communities that welcome honest difference can support belonging, while reciprocal respect keeps authenticity connected to consideration.
lilith.Twelfth_House: Black Moon Lilith in the 12th house explores desires, anger or aspects of identity that you prefer to keep private. Honest reflection can help you acknowledge these feelings and choose how to express them without shame or impulsive action.

north_node.First_House: The North Node in the 1st house frames growth around initiative, self-definition and trusting your own direction. Close relationships remain valuable, while practising independent choices helps you participate without waiting for someone else to decide who you should be.
north_node.Second_House: The North Node in the 2nd house frames growth around personal values, self-worth and the resources you can develop yourself. Building a dependable foundation supports independence, while shared support can remain part of life without becoming its only source of security.
north_node.Third_House: The North Node in the 3rd house frames growth around curiosity, conversation and attention to everyday experience. Asking questions and listening closely can broaden understanding, while letting go of the need for a complete explanation leaves room to learn.
north_node.Fourth_House: The North Node in the 4th house frames growth around belonging, emotional honesty and a supportive private life. Nurturing your foundations can create balance, while allowing rest and connection gives public achievement somewhere secure to return to.
north_node.Fifth_House: The North Node in the 5th house frames growth around creativity, personal enjoyment and the courage to express what you love. Taking part as an individual can be meaningful, even when your interests differ from the expectations of a wider group.
north_node.Sixth_House: The North Node in the 6th house frames growth around practical participation, manageable routines and useful skills. Small, repeatable actions can give your intentions shape, while keeping reflection connected to the ordinary responsibilities of daily life.
north_node.Seventh_House: The North Node in the 7th house frames growth around cooperation, reciprocity and making room for another person's perspective. Sharing decisions can deepen connection, while independence becomes more flexible when it includes the ability to negotiate and receive support.
north_node.Eighth_House: The North Node in the 8th house frames growth around trust, vulnerability and sharing responsibility. Thoughtful interdependence can deepen relationships, while learning what to release helps security become more than protecting what is already familiar.
north_node.Ninth_House: The North Node in the 9th house frames growth around perspective, meaning and experiences beyond the familiar. Exploring a guiding philosophy can connect scattered knowledge, while lived experience helps you discover which beliefs deserve your commitment.
north_node.Tenth_House: The North Node in the 10th house frames growth around responsibility, public contribution and choosing a direction of your own. Building confidence through action can make ambitions more tangible, while a supportive private life remains an important foundation.
north_node.Eleventh_House: The North Node in the 11th house frames growth around friendship, collaboration and contributing to something shared. Making room for collective needs can broaden fulfilment, while personal creativity becomes a gift you bring rather than something you must set aside.
north_node.Twelfth_House: The North Node in the 12th house frames growth around reflection, compassion and accepting what cannot be fully managed. Quiet time can restore perspective, while learning to pause helps effort become a choice rather than a constant obligation.

south_node.First_House: The South Node in the 1st house describes familiarity with independence, initiative and relying on yourself. These strengths remain useful, while growth may involve sharing decisions and recognising that cooperation can expand rather than weaken your agency.
south_node.Second_House: The South Node in the 2nd house describes familiarity with self-sufficiency, personal resources and protecting what feels secure. Practical skills provide a foundation, while greater trust and thoughtful sharing can make room for forms of support you cannot build alone.
south_node.Third_House: The South Node in the 3rd house describes familiarity with gathering information, conversation and everyday connections. Curiosity is a strength, while stepping back to form a wider perspective can help many useful details become meaningful understanding.
south_node.Fourth_House: The South Node in the 4th house describes familiarity with private life, family roles and the comfort of belonging. Emotional foundations remain valuable, while taking responsibility in the wider world can help you develop a direction beyond familiar expectations.
south_node.Fifth_House: The South Node in the 5th house describes familiarity with personal creativity, enjoyment and individual expression. These gifts can enrich your life, while collaboration helps them contribute to shared aims without requiring constant recognition.
south_node.Sixth_House: The South Node in the 6th house describes familiarity with work, problem-solving and making yourself useful. Practical competence remains a strength, while rest and reflection can loosen the habit of meeting every uncertainty with another task.
south_node.Seventh_House: The South Node in the 7th house describes familiarity with partnership, accommodation and finding direction through others. Relationship skills remain valuable, while practising independent choices helps cooperation include your own needs and priorities.
south_node.Eighth_House: The South Node in the 8th house describes familiarity with emotional intensity, shared resources and managing what is intertwined. Insight and resilience remain useful, while developing your own stable resources can make closeness feel more freely chosen.
south_node.Ninth_House: The South Node in the 9th house describes familiarity with broad beliefs, guiding principles and the search for a larger explanation. Perspective is a strength, while asking everyday questions keeps understanding responsive to details that do not fit the theory.
south_node.Tenth_House: The South Node in the 10th house describes familiarity with achievement, responsibility and being recognised for what you do. Competence remains valuable, while nurturing private life helps your identity include belonging and care as well as performance.
south_node.Eleventh_House: The South Node in the 11th house describes familiarity with communities, collective aims and finding your place among others. Collaboration remains a strength, while making room for personal enjoyment helps you discover what you love beyond what the group values.
south_node.Twelfth_House: The South Node in the 12th house describes familiarity with solitude, reflection and retreat from demanding circumstances. Inner awareness remains valuable, while manageable routines and concrete action help bring that understanding into everyday life.
